rv.q: For refreshing summertime theatrical fun, do not miss the expert comedy The Play That Goes Wrong at the Keegan Theatre!
The timing and execution of the play's many mishaps are hysterically on-target, as is the precise choreography of the cast's gag-a-minute slapstick, swooning, and swordplay.
Without exception, everyone excels at making a series of catastrophic mistakes look utterly professional.

cn.t: Critics praise this slapstick farce for its energetic physical comedy and clever subversion of murder mystery tropes, comparing it favorably to "Noises Off" with collapsing sets and escalating disasters that delight audiences.
